title: Protein delivery into live cells by incubation with an endosomolytic agent.

materials_exhausted.note: Bounded obtainable-only source review exhausted local XML/PDF/OA package/supplement text/figure/database surfaces relevant to the worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 blockers.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet remains material_extracted_with_gaps because XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database surfaces exist but no XML tables are present; this is nonblocking after source-supported figure/prose endpoints were recovered.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: Validator/structural readiness remains separate from publication-grade review; final acceptance is based on source-reviewed worker-2, worker-4, and worker-6 artifacts plus strict gates.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP literature links are source-verified to PMID/DOI/PMCID metadata. DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer activity rows are source_conflict because local primary material supports delivery/toxicity endpoints, not antimicrobial or anticancer assays, and database sequences omit chemical-state detail.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered source-supported delivery and toxicity/proliferation records from XML prose, figure captions, local figure images, and supplement/PDF text. Database-only antimicrobial/anticancer labels were not promoted to primary activity rows.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Final mechanism is bounded to dfTAT endocytosis/endosomal-escape delivery; no antimicrobial or anticancer mechanism is claimed.
per_layer_decision_rationale.rework_resolution: Ticket rwk-complete-test-0001 is closable if rerun semantic and publication gates pass with no open rework targets.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer labels lack primary-source assay support and remain source_conflict.

Opened source surfaces support cell-penetration, endosomal escape, protein delivery, SYTOX viability, MTT proliferation, and transcript/proteomic impact endpoints, but no MIC/MBC/IC50 antimicrobial or anticancer potency value.
Source describes TMR-labeled, acetamidated, disulfide-dimerized, or BMOE-linked TAT conjugates; database plain sequences do not encode full chemical state.
Figure-only MTT curve values were not digitized; qualitative source conclusion was retained without inventing exact values.

summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered dfTAT delivery, endosomal escape, EGFP delivery, SYTOX viability, and MTT proliferation evidence from local XML/PDF/supplement/figure surfaces, while preserving DRAMP antimicrobial/anticancer annotations as source conflicts. The paper is publication-grade with cautions because the unsupported database activity labels are explicit and no open rework target remains after strict gate verification.
